name: bilaga-mcp

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Upload a local file to Bilaga and return a share_url valid for 30 days. Uploads in 8 MiB parts with retries; for files of many GB this can take a long time. Optional `to` addresses the transfer to another agent's inbox by email; `in_reply_to` makes it a reply to a transfer addressed to you. If an upload was interrupted, call again with `resume` set to the transfer id from the error/log and the same unchanged file.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the local file to send.

to.description: Recipient email; the transfer appears in that account's inbox.

in_reply_to.description: Public id of a transfer addressed to you that this file replies to.

sender.description: Sender label shown on the download page and receipt.

price_cents.description: Experimental: charge the recipient this amount before download. Requires `to`.

resume.description: Private transfer id of an unfinished upload to resume.

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.description: Get the status of one of your transfers by private id, including parts uploaded, share_url, download_requests, and received_at.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: List your latest 50 transfers. Use to recover a transfer id after a lost response.

tools.name: mark_sent
tools.description: Record that you delivered the share link to the recipient. Bilaga does not send links itself.

tools.name: delete_transfer
tools.description: Revoke a share link and delete the stored bytes. Irreversible. Safe to retry.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: List transfers other agents addressed to this account's email. Entries have public_id, from_account, download_url, and receipt_url.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a transfer addressed to you by public id to a local path, and record receipt for the sender. Returns the saved path, size, and sha256. Refuses to overwrite unless overwrite=true.

out_path.description: Where to save. Defaults to the original filename in the current directory.

tools.name: acknowledge_received
tools.description: Record receipt of an addressed transfer without downloading it. Sets received_at on the sender's transfer.

tools.name: pay_transfer
tools.description: Experimental: pay for a priced transfer addressed to you from your account balance so it can be downloaded.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the account balance in cents and the last 50 ledger entries.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a transfer of the given size in bytes and whether uploading is allowed right now.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Public service limits, part size, prices, and enabled capabilities. No token needed.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Signed account events (transfer.completed, transfer.downloaded, transfer.received, transfer.reply, transfer.paid, transfer.deleted, request.submitted). Page with `since` = next_since from the previous call.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch the signed delivery receipt for a transfer by public id. Public; no token needed. Verify offline with the Python client if proof matters.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Show the account webhook and its last ten delivery attempts.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Register the single https webhook URL for this account. Public hostnames only.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Remove the account webhook.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a webhook.test event now and report the HTTP status the endpoint returned.

tools.name: create_file_request
tools.description: Create a link through which someone without an account can upload files to you. Returns id and upload_url; share the whole upload_url including its #key= fragment, which is shown only once.

reference.description: Opaque reference echoed back in status and the signed submission.

tools.name: list_file_requests
tools.description: List your latest 50 file requests.

tools.name: get_file_request
tools.description: Status of a file request: files uploaded so far, submitted_at, and the final manifest once the uploader clicked Done.

tools.name: revoke_file_request
tools.description: Revoke a file request link. Completed files keep normal retention.

tools.name: get_file_request_receipt
tools.description: Signed submission receipt for a file request after the uploader clicked Done.

instructions: Bilaga sends large files (up to 50 GB) and returns a share link valid for 30 days. Use send_file to upload a local file and get a share_url. Share only share_url, never the private transfer id. Bilaga does not deliver links; hand the share_url to the recipient through your own channel, then call mark_sent. Transfers outside the free allowance are charged from the account balance; read charged_usd on the result. On 402 insufficient_balance, stop and tell the user to add credit at https://bilaga.link/account. Addressed transfers (to=email) appear in the recipient agent's inbox; the recipient calls download_file or acknowledge_received. Poll get_transfer no faster than every 15 seconds; prefer list_events.
stderr: bilaga-mcp: no token. Run `npx -y bilaga-mcp setup` to store one (/tmp/config/bilaga/token), or set BILAGA_TOKEN. Only public tools will work until then.
